title: Bind offline CI artifacts to the actual tested commit and PR identity
outcome: Bind offline CI artifacts to the actual tested commit and PR identity
acceptance: Fix the independently reviewed CI artifact provenance gap while preserving all EC001 offline behavior. Emit an uploaded machine-readable provenance manifest for every component/job that records git rev-parse HEAD as actual tested_sha, repository, event/ref, workflow/run/attempt identity, component/Python version, and separate PR head/base SHA when present. PR merge-ref checkout must remain visibly distinct from source branch head; never label branch head as tested SHA without checking it.

Keep provenance alongside bounded JUnit/toy reports under reports/, pinned official action commits, read-only permissions, timeouts and <=7dayretention. Artifact upload/manifest diagnostic capture should run on failed checks when safe; missing data must remain missing, not fabricated successful evidence. No secrets, personal paths, API keys or automatic baseline changes.

Add evalcore/tests/test_ci_provenance.py with real executed offline generation for synthetic PR merge/head/base identities, main push, missing/malformed metadata, and a deliberately mismatched tested-head assertion. Test the actual helper/interface used by workflow, not source-string matching. A malformed/mismatched identity cannot become passing current-head evidence.

Correct docs/ci.md and MEMORY.md stale precommit report references: final exact-head author report275a611b-9048-4f03-a07f-3b677b6482dc at484cf0d is historical input; new evidence will be generated by coordinator after commit. Explain PR merge-ref versus head and pending remote execution truthfully. Do not claim remoteCI/artifacts or main-push were verified.

Read docs/morning-ec001-review.md. Preserve frozen scripts/ec001_checks.py (outside editable scope), existing gate pass/fail assertions, API/schema compatibility, and all existing8checks. The extra provenance pytest check must pass. No paid API, real .env/keys/DB, push/PR/merge/deploy or automatic acceptance.
